name: How do I know if I have a slab leak?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if I have a slab leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common indicators of a slab leak include unusual warm spots on your floors, particularly if they are consistently wet or damp. You might also notice a sudden, unexplained spike in your water bill without a change in usage. The sound of running water when all taps are off, mildew or mold odors, or visible cracks in your foundation or walls can also point to a slab leak. A decrease in water pressure in certain areas of your home can also be a symptom.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs of a slab leak include warm spots on floors, increased water bills, the sound of running water, or foundation cracks.
